Chat request with tool_choice set to required forces the model to call a tool

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    request = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"What is the weather today?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"tool_choice\":\"required\",\"tools\":[{\"function\":{\"description\":\"Get the current weather for a given location\",\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"location\":{\"description\":\"The city name\",\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"location\"],\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"function\"}]}")
    result = await client.chat(request)
    print(result.choices)
    print(result.choices[0].message.tool_calls)
    print(result.choices[0].message.tool_calls[0].function.name)
    print(result.choices[0].finish_reason)

asyncio.run(main())
```
